app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx BottomBar uses tabPress event + canPreventDefault + navigate — correct pattern for expo-router-material-top-tabs interop. Active pill uses colors.tealGlow — good visual affordance.

app/(tabs)/research.tsx TabView uses `lazy` + `swipeEnabled` + custom TabBar with per-tab testIDs via options={}. Scrollable, indicator slides — good. Note: because both the main pager AND the Research subtab pager are horizontal, when on Research the inner pager captures horizontal swipes and you cannot swipe out of Research to Strategy/Workspace with a gesture (bottom-tab tap works). This is documented as the KNOWN/EXPECTED LIMITATION in the review request and is NOT reported as a bug.
